title: Local AI
subtitle: See whether EVE's local AI is ready on this Mac. EVE manages it automatically and uses the cloud whenever something is missing locally.

remediation.title: Prepare local AI
remediation.cloudReassurance: EVE keeps working in the cloud until local AI is ready.

external-link.title: A local component is missing
external-link.body: For the local AI to run on this Mac, a runtime component must be installed. EVE can guide you through setup — or simply keep working in the cloud.
external-link.actionHint: EVE can open a step-by-step walkthrough as a page for you.
external-link.explainer: OLLAMA_MISSING / OLLAMA_NOT_RUNNING: the local runtime is missing or not running.

pull-progress.title: The local model is being prepared
pull-progress.bodyFetching: The local model is not (fully) downloaded yet. Once the download is running, you'll see the progress here.
pull-progress.bodyFailed: The local model download was interrupted. Once you're back online it can start again.
pull-progress.explainer: MODEL_NOT_FETCHED / MODEL_PULL_FAILED: the model weights are being fetched locally.

cloud-redirect.titleRam: Not enough memory for the local AI
cloud-redirect.titleDisk: Not enough free disk space for the local AI
cloud-redirect.body: This Mac can't run the local model — and that's perfectly fine. The cloud AI is your default lane and runs immediately.
cloud-redirect.explainer: BLOCKED_RAM / BLOCKED_DISK: the local lane's hardware requirement isn't met.

reinstall.title: This one's on us
reinstall.body: A bundled component doesn't fit your system. This isn't your fault — reinstalling Command EVE fixes it. We never hand you a terminal command here.
reinstall.explainer: PYTHON_/HERMES_ class: a bundled runtime component is missing or mismatched.

kanban.governanceLocked: Automatic external changes are switched off
kanban.governanceOpen: Some protection rules are not active yet

tierDescriptions.gemma-4-e4b-local-default: For quick everyday tasks and short answers.
tierDescriptions.gemma-4-12b-local-planning: For broader planning and structured analysis.
tierDescriptions.gemma-4-31b-local-pro: For demanding local work on high-performance Macs.
tierDescriptions.unknown: For local tasks on this Mac.

receiptNextAction.ready: EVE can use local AI automatically.
receiptNextAction.blocked: EVE keeps working in the cloud and leaves local AI switched off.
receiptNextAction.failed: EVE keeps working in the cloud. Local setup can be checked again later.
receiptNextAction.skipped: Nothing to do. EVE sets up local AI when needed.
receiptNextAction.unknown: EVE checks the next safe step automatically.

warnings.title: Status note
warnings.publicSummary: Local AI is not fully prepared yet. EVE keeps working reliably in the cloud in the meantime.
warnings.publicTaskSummary: Some local task data is not available yet. Core functions remain usable.
warnings.runtime_receipt_missing: No runtime receipt has been written yet
warnings.runtime_receipt_schema_mismatch: Runtime receipt has an unexpected schema
warnings.runtime_receipt_json_invalid: Runtime receipt is not valid JSON
warnings.model_warmup_receipt_missing: No model warm-up receipt has been written yet
warnings.model_warmup_receipt_schema_mismatch: Model warm-up receipt has an unexpected schema
warnings.model_warmup_receipt_json_invalid: Model warm-up receipt is not valid JSON
warnings.runtime_reconciliation_schema_mismatch: Runtime reconciliation has an unexpected schema
warnings.runtime_reconciliation_json_invalid: Runtime reconciliation is not valid JSON
warnings.hermes_version_lookup_failed: The local runtime version could not be read
warnings.kanban_board_read_failed: Local task data could not be read
warnings.kanban_optional_dashboard_api_unavailabl: An optional local view is unavailable; core functions remain usable
warnings.kanban_board_db_missing_read_only_no_mut: Local task data is not present yet; the safety check changed nothing
warnings.kanban_python_probe_nonzero_exit: The local task check did not complete successfully
warnings.ollama_probe_unavailable: The local AI is unavailable — its installation status is unknown

errors.loadFailed: Runtime status could not be loaded.
errors.loadFailedDescription: EVE could not read the local AI status right now. Cloud AI remains available.
errors.kanbanLoadFailed: Local tasks could not be checked.
errors.kanbanLoadFailedDescription: EVE could not read local task data right now. Your saved tasks remain unchanged.

blocked.title: Local AI unavailable
blocked.description: EVE could not check local AI right now. Cloud AI remains available.
blocked.electronBridgeRequired: Runtime status requires the Electron bridge.

empty.noReceipt: Local AI has not been set up yet.
empty.noWarmup: Local AI has not been started yet.
